question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling error in the given sentence.

The serene osterity of the compound had a unique charm.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Austerity)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Osterity"** is incorrect and does not have a meaning in English. (No Hindi equivalent)
 
• **"Austerity"** refers to sternness or severity in attitude, manner, or appearance. It can also mean extreme frugality or simplicity. (सादगी या कठोरता)
 
 
• **Example:** The monk led a life of austerity, shunning all material comforts.
 
 
 
• The serene "austerity" of the compound refers to its simple yet unique and charming atmosphere.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Austerity)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Asterity** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): This is an incorrect spelling and has no meaning in English.
 
• **Option 2: Ousterity** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): This is also an incorrect spelling and does not exist in English.
 
• **Option 4: Aughsterity** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): Another incorrect spelling without any meaning.
